description:
Cast Mox Diamond either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Choose to sacrifice Mox Diamond instead of having it enter the battlefield.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mox Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
